One study evaluating targeted therapy is the Clinical trial name: Irinotecan in Treating Patients With Metastatic or Inoperable Thyroid Cancer [3]. Another relevant study is the Clinical trial name: Tanespimycin in Treating Patients With Inoperable Locoregionally Advanced or Metastatic Thyroid Cancer [4]. The search also returned the Clinical trial name: Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5].

## Morphology Context

One identified concept in the medical genetics database is the medgen title: Medullary Carcinoma, Not Otherwise Specified [7]. Additionally, related literature includes the pubmed title: Prognostic value of morphology and hormone receptor status in breast cancer - a population-based study. [6]. This paper is formally cataloged as Publication pmid: 15365566 [8]. In this study, survival outcomes were observed to be lower for not otherwise specified cases compared to distinct subtypes [9: "5-year relative survival ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma to 95% (95% CI 90-100) for special types"].

The final trial result is Suberoylanilide Hydroxamic Acid in Treating Patients With Metastatic and/or Locally Advanced or Locally Recurrent Thyroid Cancer [5]. ## Literature Context
Supporting literature includes the article Prognostic value of morphology and hormone receptor status in breast cancer - a population-based study. [6]. This article corresponds to Publication pmid: 15365566 [8]. The study analyzed survival rates, noting a specific rate for not otherwise specified carcinoma [9: "5-year relative survival ranged from 66% (95% CI 61-71) for NOS carcinoma"]. Furthermore, tumor morphology and hormone receptors independently predicted survival outcomes [9: "Morphology and hormone receptor status were confirmed as significant survival predictors"].
